reason: Reports cooking loss (weight loss relative to the thermally untreated sample) and shear force of chicken and turkey cuts after named culinary techniques and devices.
foods: chicken (Ross 308) and turkey (BUT Big 6) breast fillet, breast cubes, thigh (whole) and thigh fillet
treatments: broiling (CO, MEP), grilling (gas grill GG, contact grill CG at 163 °C), frying of breaded fillets (CO, non-stick pan PF), stewing with water 750–800 mL per 1 kg (CO, MEP), roasting (hot air oven HAO and CO at 163 °C); all to 75 ± 1 °C core, 7–16 min; 1.00% NaCl surface salting before cooking
methods_quote: The total cooking time for all methods was in the range of 7 to 16 min until the center of the product reached 75 ± 1°C (controlled by a thermometer probe directly into the sample).
retention_quote: CL values were determined according to Barbanti and Pasquini (2005) and expressed as g/100 g by weight difference between thermally untreated and thermally treated samples.
replicates: All analyses were performed at least in triplicate.
